services.name: NetworkManager.service
services.purpose: Network connectivity for the installed workstation.
services.security_implications: Manages network interfaces; wireless credentials must not be logged.

services.name: systemd-timesyncd.service
services.security_implications: Uses configured network time sources; accurate time is required for TLS.

services.name: docker.service
services.purpose: Optional container workloads; start only when requested.
services.security_implications: Published container ports may bypass host firewall expectations; Docker access can grant root-equivalent privileges.

services.name: sshd.service
services.purpose: SSH server is not enabled by default.
services.security_implications: Enabling exposes a remote login surface; configure keys and firewall rules first.

services.name: tailscaled.service
services.security_implications: May alter routing and DNS; do not activate alongside another VPN without an explicit routing plan.

services.name: netbird.service
services.security_implications: May alter routing and DNS; do not activate alongside another VPN without an explicit routing plan.

services.name: postgresql.service
services.security_implications: Database listeners must remain local unless deliberately exposed.

services.name: redis.service
services.security_implications: Cache listeners must remain local unless deliberately exposed.

services.name: cups.service
services.security_implications: Network printing can expose local services and device metadata.

services.name: avahi-daemon.service
services.security_implications: Advertises and discovers services on the local network.

services.name: nix-daemon.service
services.purpose: Runs only when the Nix development environment is installed.
services.security_implications: Privileged build service; restrict access to trusted local users and reviewed Nix configuration.
